title: A form page whose submit binds to the write, gated on the load that precedes it
note: AI-AG-005, AI-AG-013, FR-UII-002: the submit's source is the page's create operation, the fields cite the approved elements they collect, the save is unreachable until the load resolved, and the states carry submitting, success and validation error. The form field the Registry cannot supply is asked about instead of invented.

items.label: visit-form.md
items.content: The paper form records: date of the visit, weight in kilograms, systolic blood pressure, and whether the urine dipstick was done. The midwife insists the screen must not let her save a visit for a pregnancy she did not open first.

expected.summary: Designed the record form: the pregnancy header reads through this page's load operation, the three fields the form carries map to their approved elements, and save posts through the create operation, which stays disabled until the load has returned an active enrollment — the order the midwife asked for is a property of the screen, not of her memory. After a save the page shows what the read-back operation returns rather than what was typed. Validation errors, submitting and success states are all designed. The urine dipstick is on the paper form but has no approved element behind it, so it is asked about rather than added to the payload.

decisions.subject: anc-record-form

selected.option: one screen, fields in the order the paper form lists them

alternatives.option: a two-step stepper, measurements then confirmation
alternatives.reasonRejected: The visit has four fields and the midwife enters them while the woman is present; a second step adds a round trip for no confirmation anyone reads.

decisions.rationale: The paper form is already the order of use, and the page's job is to be faster than it, not different from it.

value.purpose: Record one antenatal visit against the pregnancy the user opened.
layout: save action pinned at the bottom

components.name: Card
components.use: Show which pregnancy is being recorded against, so a wrong entry is visible before it is saved.

components.name: Calendar
components.use: Date of the visit, defaulting to today and never later than today.
validation: the date may not be in the future

components.name: LinearProgramStage
components.use: Carry the program rule that flags a raised reading onto the screen as the systolic value changes.
components.visibleWhen: a systolic value has been entered

components.name: Button
components.visibleWhen: the pregnancy loaded with an active enrollment and the form is valid

components.name: NoticeBox
components.use: After saving, state what was recorded and by whom.

interactions: the save is unreachable until the load has returned
a rejected save keeps every typed value on screen
after a success the page shows the read-back values, not the typed ones
testScenarios: opening the page for a pregnancy with no active enrollment offers no save
a rejected weight keeps the rest of the form and names the field
after a save the confirmation shows the value the server stored

questions.text: The paper form records whether a urine dipstick was done, but no approved element carries it and this page's create operation has no field for it. Is the dipstick collected on this screen, and if so which element holds it?

suggestions.rationale: Then the form is complete as designed and the paper step stays paper.

suggestions.text: Collected, and an element has to be mapped first
suggestions.rationale: Neither this screen nor its API run can add the element; it is a MAPPING change request, after which both runs need the field.
